description: Defines an enumeration 'FieldType' with different data types (INT, INT16, BIT, FLOAT) and methods to retrieve associated command strings for loading and storing data of these types.

classes.name: FieldType
classes.description: An enum representing various data field types with utility methods for command generation.

methods.name: getTypeForCommand
methods.description: Private method that returns a string representing the type used in commands, based on the enum value.

methods.name: getLoadCommand
methods.description: Returns the command string to load data of this type.

methods.name: getStoreCommand
methods.description: Returns the command string to store data of this type.
